caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, sculptural object that consists of a detailed black or dark grey depiction of a seated dog with a thick coat. The dog is placed centrally on a stylized, rectangular base with curved and decorative edges. Rising from behind the dog, there is an upright ornamental structure that branches out horizontally at the top, forming a frame-like extension. This extension is symmetrically decorated, with the heads of two different animals—likely a wolf or dog and a horse—projecting from either side of the upper horizontal bar. There are additional decorative flourishes connecting the animal heads to the central vertical bar, and at the very top of the structure, there is a smaller, ornate rectangular frame. The entire composition is rendered in shades of black and grey, giving it a metallic or graphite appearance on a plain, light beige background. There is no coloration other than the monochromatic scheme, and all detailing relies on fine shading and linework.
title: Umbrella Stand
